rules.name: xoga713-legacy-var-view-definitions
rules.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS view_name, CHAR_LENGTH(VIEW_DEFINITION) AS definition_length, VIEW_DEFINITION AS definition FROM information_schema.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbsystemuat' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('helper_var_future_view_cfs', 'helper_var_vanilla_view_cfs', 'helper_var_accounting_report_cfs', 'helper_var_future_view_grn', 'helper_var_vanilla_view_grn', 'helper_var_accounting_report_grn', 'helper_var_future_view_usg', 'helper_var_vanilla_view_usg', 'helper_var_accounting_report_usg') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

expect.reason: three views for each of cfs, grn and usg
